newsitem.title: USA: Stepan Co sees record 1997 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Stepan Co sees record 1997 earnings.

text.p: Chemical company Stepan Co said Thursday it still expects record earnings for 1997 despite reporting lower net income in the first quarter.
"Our confidence for the year remains very high and we expect to achieve record earnings," F. Quinn Stepan, chairman and president, said in a statement.
The company reported first quarter earnings of $0.43 per primary share versus $0.54 last year, pressured by increased raw material costs. Revenues rose to $139.67 million from $130.64 million.

"Successful surfactant pricing adjustments recently have been made to compensate for the increased raw material costs that lowered first quarter results," Stepan said. "Higher sales volumes met our expectations for the quarter and should continue to improve over the remainder of the year."
Competitive pricing pressure in Europe as well as declines in sales volumes and profit margins in the company's Canadian and Mexican operations also hurt first quarter results, Stepan said.
